from scipy import ndimage

def regions(grid):
    l,n = ndimage.label(grid>0)
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ys,xs=np.where(l==i)
        r0,r1,c0,c1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
        m=l[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]==i
        sub=grid[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]
        out.append(dict(id=i,r0=r0,r1=r1,c0=c0,c1=c1,box=m.shape,cells=int(m.sum()),
                        nines=int((m&(sub==9)).sum()),mask=m,sub=sub,lab=l,g=grid))
    return out

demos = [(di,do),(d2i,d2o),(d3i,d3o),(d4i,d4o)]
rows=[]
H=W=15
for k,(gi,go) in enumerate(demos):
    for R in regions(gi):
        m=R['mask']; h,w=R['box']; n=R['nines']; cells=R['cells']
        npos=[(y,x) for y,x in zip(*np.where(m&(R['sub']==9)))]
        gy=[y+R['r0'] for y,x in npos]; gx=[x+R['c0'] for y,x in npos]
        feats={}
        feats['nines']=n
        feats['cells']=cells
        feats['h']=h; feats['w']=w
        feats['density']=n/cells
        feats['ratio']=cells/max(n,1)
        feats['n_eq_h']=int(n==h); feats['n_eq_w']=int(n==w)
        feats['interior']=int(R['r0']>0 and R['c0']>0 and R['r1']<H-1 and R['c1']<W-1)
        feats['touch']=int(not feats['interior'])

        feats['all_distinct_rc']=int(len(set(gy))==n and len(set(gx))==n)
        # collinear 9s (any straight line)
        coll=False
        if n>=2:
            for (y1,x1),(y2,x2) in itertools.combinations(npos,2):
